authority: Jamie Burkart authorized archival research and portfolio use; image-specific credit, consent, crop, caption, editorial, deployment, and indexing decisions remain separate.
scope: Published NYC Artist Coalition Ghost records and deployed application source references for Fair Rent NYC (original application), Let NYC Dance, Talks Not Raids, and Save NYC Spaces.
exclusions: Dependency, build, temporary, and unreferenced storage files are outside the occurrence denominator. Every recovered source reference is retained and classified, including non-photographic graphics and identity assets.

populationContract.denominator: Every image reference in rendered published Ghost HTML plus featured-image fields; every image reference in deployed Ember application source; and every image reference in the complete current Fair Rent public sitemap crawl.
populationContract.ghostRepresentationRule: Rendered HTML is canonical when present; stored Markdown is used only when rendered HTML is absent.
populationContract.responsiveImageRule: Responsive size variants normalize to the underlying content-image path.
populationContract.deduplicationRule: Recovered files deduplicate by SHA-256 across sites. Unrecovered public images deduplicate by site and normalized public reference.
